capture.zh: 在浮空仙岛挑战天马一族长老库里，打败获得精元。

strategy_notes.zh: 先消强化，纳多雷反转约3次，布鲁海洋之心约3次，自杀型精灵上场，再由水球精灵强化2次后大招击杀（伤害7000+，强化3次9000+）。

engine_notes: random_heal: 'has a chance to heal' (有几率回血) — chance and amount not given (20% / 10% max HP are placeholders). Its 星光奔腾击 already has 15% to heal 1/4 HP; the 'chance to heal' may simply be that effect.
海洋之心 works (used in the reference strategy).
skills: species 1418's last four at or below Lv80. 星光奔腾击 (15% chance to heal 1/4 HP) is named as a Boss trait (4399 2012-11-09, 7k7k 2012-11-12); the other three are not named.
reward: original reward was the species' 精元 (essence), hatched in the 分子转化器 into the base form (e.g. 兰斯特 精元 → 卡斯, 伊索里 → 伊索的精元); encoded as the base-form species at Lv1.
Immune to 烧伤、冻伤、中毒; 海洋之心 and 惩戒之光 work. Its healing is the 15% quarter-HP heal of 星光奔腾击 (13292), not a separate trait (4399 2012-11-07).
source_note: 7k7k 2012-11-12: 体力1w, 有几率回血, 攻击+2, 普通系.
